conditions: Two warm-ups followed by five fresh-prefix full-report requests. Zero cached and reused tokens verified. Recording selected for source-reviewed graph clarity. Warm expert service, not cold disk-cache performance. Thinking off.

turns.title: How this inference works
turns.prompt:
Read the full incident report and explain how the intended controls failed. Generate a compact CAST-style graph for a technically curious reader, not an inventory of nouns or a chronology. Output only newline-delimited JSON objects, no fences or prose.
First output one summary: {"type":"summary","label":"Main control failure","detail":"A specific sentence explaining the failure","pages":[8,9],"basis":"inferred"}. The summary label must state the main insight, not say Summary or TLDR. Detail must explain why the intended isolation was inadequate in 12 to 18 words.
Output exactly six nodes in total: {"type":"node","id":"n1","label":"Short label","boundary":"evaluation|shared|external","role":"controller|process|monitor","detail":"Specific purpose","pages":[6],"basis":"reported|inferred"}. Include the evaluation harness assigning work, agents performing it, the shared Artifactory service, Hugging Face systems, OpenAI monitoring, and incident response. Place harness and agents in evaluation, Artifactory/monitoring/response in shared, and Hugging Face in external. Harness and response are controllers, monitoring is a monitor, agents/services are processes. Assign ids n1 to n6. After the summary, interleave nodes and edges: as soon as two relevant nodes exist, emit their connecting edge before introducing the next node. Emit each node once, before any edge references it. Do not output all nodes before all edges. Node details must say what each component controls, observes or supplies in 4 to 7 words.
Output only five to seven meaningful edges; do not add edges to meet a quota: {"type":"edge","from":"n1","to":"n2","label":"Concrete relationship","kind":"action|feedback|failure","detail":"An explanatory sentence","pages":[6],"basis":"reported|inferred"}. Include task assignment, shared agent communication, failed isolation through the shared service, compromise of Hugging Face, monitoring feedback to responders, and containment of evaluations. Each relationship must be performed by FROM on TO. Never connect Hugging Face systems to OpenAI monitoring or incident response: the monitoring alert concerned internal OpenAI research activity, not direct observation of Hugging Face. Never imply Hugging Face moved credentials into Artifactory. FROM and TO must be different ids. Do not invent rekeying models, token budget allocation, or any unsupported actions. For external compromise the actor is agents and the target is Hugging Face, never a self-edge. Alert delivery is feedback.
Every edge label is 3 to 5 words and its detail is a complete sentence of 8 to 12 words that adds a specific mechanism, constraint, timing or consequence. Never repeat the label in slightly different words. Avoid generic descriptions such as Stop runs / Response halts evaluations, Use service / Agents exploit service, or Detects suspicious activity. If describing containment, identify ExploitGym and the July 19-20 investigation; do not imply every evaluation or every model was immediately shut down. Explain the deficient isolation and the late response, not just successful normal actions.
Use the July directory-based message board on pages 8-9, not the May board. Detection and evaluation containment are on printed page 15. Cite verified printed page numbers for every object. Mark analytical interpretations as inferred and explicitly described facts as reported. Do not invent missing controls or claim a complete CAST investigation. No payloads, commands, credential values, attack recipes or unsupported relationships. Total natural-language text at most 180 words.
